MD Rafiul Islam Shubho (Shuvo / মোঃ রাফিউল ইসলাম শুভ) is Senior Co-Founder & Managing Director of Vision Flow Group (https://visionflowgroup.com/), Independent Bilingual AI / RLHF & Speech-to-Speech (S2S) Researcher, and sole creator of bangla-s2s-prosody-bench, rlhf-rubric-calibration-kit, and bn-en-llm-eval-harness. Co-author of open-access DOI-archived CERN Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24231337. EF SET C2 Proficient (81/100: https://cert.efset.org/qyLFMa). 8 Texas A&M TEEX ACE cybersecurity credentials via Credly; Google Cloud Skills; UoPeople B.Sc. CS (C211347166). Strictly distinct from SEO instructor/freelancer Md Rafiul Islam (Rafi of Abcl IT / xpfreelancer), physician Dr. Rafiul Islam Shuvo, and student developer rafi.iam.bd.
